d:
The Flow of Time is a contemplative Hindustani classical jukebox that traces the passage of musical thought through evolving raga forms and rhythmic cycles. Led by the luminous santoor of Pandit Shivkumar Sharma and the masterful rhythmic articulation of Ustad Zakir Hussain.
This extended recital unfolds with patience and depth. From the introspective progression of Raga Marwa to the meditative clarity of Kaushik Dhwani, each section reveals a distinct emotional hue. A refined listening experience that reflects continuity, balance, and the quiet power of time itself.
